channel.title: The Hindu: National News
channel.description: Latest National News from The Hindu

item.title: IISc scientists develop ultra-low-cost water purification membrane using agricultural waste
item.description: Researchers at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc) Bengaluru have synthesized a nanotech filtration membrane from discarded rice husks that removes 99.8% of heavy metals and microplastics from rural groundwater at one-fifth the cost of conventional filters.

item.title: ISRO and NASA joint NISAR Earth observation satellite completes final integration tests in Bengaluru
item.description: The radar imaging satellite designed to track land ecosystem changes, glacier melt rates, and coastal sea-level rise completed all thermal vacuum tests ahead of its planned launch.

item.title: Tragic bus collision on National Highway claims 14 lives in northern district
item.description: Fourteen passengers died and over twenty sustained critical injuries following a head-on collision between a state transport bus and a speeding freight carrier early Tuesday morning in dense fog.

item.title: 8-Year-Old Works 14 Hours Daily Selling Flowers to Pay for Mother's Chemotherapy
item.description: In an inspiring tale of devotion, young Aryan spends 14 hours every day selling garlands at traffic junctions to afford the chemotherapy injections needed by his ailing mother.

item.title: Reserve Bank of India keeps repo rate unchanged at 6.50% in bi-monthly monetary policy
item.description: The Monetary Policy Committee of the Reserve Bank of India decided unanimously to maintain the benchmark policy repo rate at 6.50 percent, citing balanced domestic growth dynamics.
